description:
What is the Old and New Covenant? We’ll open the Bible and explore these important questions and more. Join us for clear answers and encouraging truth straight from God’s Word.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  Can you please explain Isaiah 45:7?  
   
2. Can you please explain Numbers 15:32-36? It seems like God is cruel to the Israelites because they complained so much. 

3.  What does the Bible say about being a Narcissist?    

4.  What is the meaning of Revelations 2:10-11? I don't understand why the righteous that overcomes will not be hurt by the second death? If they are righteous, why will they need to die the second time? 

5.  What is the meaning of Hebrew 8:13? Does it mean the first 5 Books of the Law are obsolete or just the priestly atonements?    

6. According to the Bible there are 3 heavens. In which heaven was Satan's heart lifted up? 

7.  I've been married and divorced 3 times before the age of 40. Since being rebaptized, am I now destined to be alone until my death to not be an adulteress again?   
Is it okay for a divorced woman who has since become a Christian to remarry?  

8. In John 14:16-17, Jesus said He will leave the Spirit of truth with the disciples that the world cannot accept because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. Was this a special Spirit that dwelled within the disciples? Is it different from the Spirit that dwells within us today? Can you please explain John 14:16-17?

9. Matthew 24:20 states "Pray that your flight may not be in winter or on the Sabbath". Which Sabbath is this referring to, the Jewish Sabbath or the Christian Sabbath?  What Sabbath is Matthew 24:20 referring to? 

 10. On a previous Bible Q&A someone asked if our name was in the Book of Life at the beginning of our life. I only see our name being blotted out, not added to the Book of Life. Is our name written in there already? When is our name in the Book of Life?
